newsitem.title: USA: Fla. 620 MW Seminole coal unit 1 seen back today.
newsitem.headline: Fla. 620 MW Seminole coal unit 1 seen back today.

text.p: A 620 megawatt (MW) unit at the coal-fired Seminole generating station is set to resume operation Wednesday, as expected, following its seasonal maintenance outage, the operator said.
"Unit 1 is being brought back today," said a spokesman for Seminole Electric Cooperative.
The adjoining Seminole unit, also rated at 620 MW, was running at full output, the spokesman added.
The Seminole units are in Palatka, Fla.
